query: Ugh, my neighbor’s tabby cat keeps sneaking onto my fire escape to knock over my potted succulents, I swear I’ve had to replant that tiny jade plant three times in the last month. I spent twenty minutes last night watching TikTok tutorials for DIY cat deterrent sprays that use citrus peels, but I’m worried the smell will stick to my apartment curtains and bother my roommate who’s super sensitive to strong scents. I also stopped at the corner bodega on my walk home yesterday and they were out of my usual lemon seltzer, so I had to get the lime one which tastes way too tart for my liking. Anyway, I’m looking for pantry staples right now: I need gluten-reduced pecan items, and my budget is $50 max.
